StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: A documentary animation project owned by a MotionStory Studio user.

storyAnalysis.description: Optional Phase 5 AI story analysis summary and approval state.

projectAudioClips.description: Optional bounded list (max 20) of project-level music/ambient audio clips.

StudioScene.title: StudioScene
StudioScene.description: An individual 2D animated documentary scene with multi-character cast assignments.

characterCast.description: Bounded list (max 12) of character placements with scene-specific expression, action, pose, layer, z-order, visibility, and transforms.

sceneElements.description: Bounded list (max 24) of visual scene elements (props, midground/foreground/background image layers) with transforms, z-order, and visibility.

layerStates.description: Bounded list (max 6) of scene compositing layer visibility, ordering, opacity, and depth metadata.

animationKeyframes.description: Bounded list (max 200) of deterministic time-based keyframes for character transforms, visual element transforms, and camera zoom/pan.

characterActingCues.description: Bounded list (max 60) of time-based character acting cues (expression, action, poseView, optional referenceSheetId) within a scene.

cinematics.description: Cinematic camera framing, 2D depth/parallax, lighting/color grading, atmosphere weather, and post-processing VFX settings for the scene.

scenePlan.description: Phase 5 AI scene planning metadata (location, environment, tone, visual/camera/lighting/audio suggestions, approval lock).

dialogueLines.description: Bounded list (max 40) of multi-speaker dialogue lines linked to permanent character IDs and timing.

audioClips.description: Bounded list (max 40) of positioned multi-track scene audio clips (narration, dialogue, music, SFX, ambient) with trim/volume/fade/loop.

lipSyncCues.description: Bounded list (max 240) of deterministic viseme mouth-state cues synchronized with dialogue timing and audio envelopes.

soundSuggestions.description: Bounded list (max 20) of AI-suggested music, SFX, and ambient cues for the scene.

motionGraphics.description: Bounded list (max 30) of editable Phase 6 animated titles, lower thirds, infographics, and documentary map graphics.

subtitleCues.description: Bounded list (max 80) of structured timed subtitle cues for the scene.

subtitleStyle.description: Scene-level subtitle typography, color, outline, background, alignment, and vertical placement configuration.

outgoingTransition.description: Composited transition configuration from this scene into the next scene.

graphicSuggestions.description: Bounded list (max 20) of reviewable AI graphic and infographic suggestions for this scene.

StudioCharacter.title: StudioCharacter
StudioCharacter.description: Full reusable 2D documentary character profile with visual identity consistency metadata and primary reference image.

voiceLanguage.description: Preferred speech synthesis language for this character.

voiceId.description: Preferred on-device TTS voice identifier for this character.

CharacterReferenceSheet.title: CharacterReferenceSheet
CharacterReferenceSheet.description: Generated 2D character turnaround view, expression, or pose reference image linked to a permanent character profile.

imageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG or transparent PNG Base64 payload (max 320,000 chars) for AI-generated backgrounds and props.

hasTransparency.description: Verified pixel alpha transparency flag for generated or imported visual assets.

visualStyle.description: Documentary 2D art style used to generate the visual asset.

promptUsed.description: Prompt summary used when generating the visual asset.

graphicPayloadJson.description: Optional serialized Phase 6 MotionGraphicElement template JSON (max 32,000 chars) for reusable motion graphic templates.

StudioAudioAsset.title: StudioAudioAsset
StudioAudioAsset.description: Persistent audio metadata entry (imported file or synthesized TTS WAV stored in app-private storage; no raw audio blobs in Firestore).

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/sce.description: Ordered 2D animated scenes belonging to a project.

/users/{userId}/characters/{characterId}.description: Reusable character profiles with permanent IDs and consistency blueprints.
Generated character turnaround views, expressions, and pose reference images.

/users/{userId}/audioAssets/{audioAssetI.description: User audio asset metadata entries (narration, dialogue, music, SFX, ambient).
